items.desc: Music has always been CARISTA’s way of finding connection. She founded United Identities in Utrecht in 2017, and it has since developed into an independent record label, events and a monthly show on NTS Radio. Her own “No Ego, All Equal” ethos sits at its centre — a belief in openness, and giving music room to find its own. Enjoy!
items.title: ITPS132 CARISTA

items.desc: Fireground are known for their high energy live sets and slamming records on Tresor and Ilian Tape. This is a rare DJ mix from the duo, recorded with vinyl only. Enjoy!
items.title: ITPS131 FIREGROUND

items.desc: For decades, Munich DJ Muallem has been a driving force in the city’s electronic music scene. Fresh off the closure of the Blitz club - which he co-ran as a creative force and resident for nine years - he continues to curate his own label, Childhood. Enjoy!
items.title: ITPS130 MUALLEM

items.desc: Erika dreams on the cellular level, or perhaps of transdimensional intelligences moving through strange patterns on celestial objects, working towards a mysterious goal. Her connection to the dreamworld becomes concrete in her approach to music, simultaneously so solid and yet so ethereal. Enjoy!
items.title: ITPS129 ERIKA

items.desc: Dialog is a Dub project by Samuel van Dijk from the Netherlands and Rasmus Hedlund from Finland. Their debut release came out on the fantastic Astral Industries in 2022 followed by a series of dope records on their own label DOT Records. Available on SoundCloud & Apple Podcasts. Enjoy!
items.title: ITPS128 DIALOG

items.desc: Mareena's deep connection with electronic music began in her early teenage years in East Germany, where she experienced the quaking rise of techno. She has earned a long-standing residency (since 2012) in the techno institution Tresor and her ability to include hard and elegant elements into her vinyl-oriented sets has led her to play at renowned clubs across the globe. Enjoy!
items.title: ITPS127 MAREENA

items.desc: Sun People is merging Footwork, Jungle, and Techno influences into a unique and distinctive sound that led to releases on renowned labels like Exit, Defrostatica, Rua Sound or Candy Mountain. To further expand his musical sphere he recently started a label called All Things Records that will focus on his own works and collaborative projects with like-minded musicians. Enjoy!
items.title: ITPS126 SUN PEOPLE

items.desc: René Löwe, aka Vainqueur, has released highly influential records on Maurizio, Chain Reaction, and his co-founded label Scion Versions. Together with his label partner Substance, aka DJ Pete, he also performs live as Scion. A true pioneer of dub techno. Enjoy!
items.title: ITPS125 VAINQUEUR

items.desc: Beatrice M. has released dope records on labels like Tectonic and Tempa. For this mix the Bait label head teamed up with Tim Reaper, Future Retro London label boss and lover of all things Jungle, Drum & Bass and Hardcore - with an impressive discography. Enjoy!
items.title: ITPS124 BEATRICE M. & TIM REAPER

items.desc: London mainstay RIZ LA TEEF has been on the scene for a number of years, coming up only playing vinyl and cutting dubplates showcasing the Garage, Funky, Dubstep and Grime UK sounds. This mix is a nod to his roots as it is vinyl/dubplate only featuring his trademark smooth mixing and long blends. Enjoy!
items.title: ITPS123 RIZ LA TEEF

items.desc: Aubrey has been releasing dope records for more than 30 years and has founded five labels. He also runs the Latitude record store in Berlin, and he’s still remixing, mastering, djing, and involved in all things music. It’s safe to say that he is a true legend. Enjoy!
items.title: ITPS122 AUBREY

items.desc: Akua has been at the forefront of a new generation of techno connoisseurs that expertly channel the timeless energy of 90s and early 2000s into their artistry. The Ghanaian-American DJ first established herself in the influential New York underground techno world and moved to Berlin in 2023. Akua’s sets are refreshing and inspire audiences to remember the true essence of techno. Enjoy!
items.title: ITPS121 AKUA

items.desc: Arthur, known for his work at Hard Wax & Open Ground, presenting a crispy take on Amapiano. Enjoy!
items.title: ITPS120 ARTHUR

items.desc: This mix is a sampler for an upcoming various artists album via Tresor x Limited Network coming early next year. With music from: 5tr8tch GiGi Galaxy Sugar JPWatts Max Watts Skee Mask Available on SoundCloud and Apple Podcasts. Enjoy!
items.title: ITPS119 LIMITED NETWORK

items.desc: Olgica grew up in Serbia and is now living in Austria. She throws events in both countries and beyond. Left field bass, dub, broken techno, experimental downtempo and dizziyng halftime tunes are attributes of Olgicas sets. Enjoy!
items.title: ITPS118 OLGICA

items.desc: An artist with minimal online presence, Commodo is one of an increasingly rare few who make waves through the strength of their music alone. He builds bass-focused beats with soul and substance that never perpetuate a formula. Together with Gantz he just released a monster record on our ITX series. Enjoy!
items.title: ITPS117 COMMODO

items.desc: INVT is the multidisciplinary art project of Luca Medici and Delbert Perez. The duo specialize in electronic music and fashion design. Luca and Delbert have grown their audience through their high energy live sets as well as their DJ sets and various independent releases that are all produced, mixed, and mastered by the two. This mix was recorded at their new party series Calentón. Enjoy! Watch the entire session: https://youtu.be/_gH9b3jsud4
items.title: ITPS116 INVT

items.desc: Tresor Resident LNS started out organizing warehouse parties in Vancouver, Canada. Since residing in Berlin her style of classic techno, house, electro and braindance can easily be identified in her studio productions and DJ sets. Her collaborations with DJ Sotofett are regularly released on Tresor Records and WANIA, while her solo productions and remixes have been released by Counter 99, Emotional Response, Freakout Cult, Sex Tags Ufo and DFA. Enjoy!
items.title: ITPS115 LNS

items.desc: Reeko, also known as Architectural, started DJing in the late 90s and producing in the early 2000s, and he has released countless timeless records since. He founded the labels Mental Disorder and Evidence and was part of the PoleGroup collective for a decade. Collaborations with Surgeon, Oscar Mulero and Exium, as well as releases on many legendary labels, are part of his discography. His recent explorations on the Drum & Bass label Samurai make it clear that Juan Rico has found new ways to experiment with his sound. Available on SoundCloud & Apple Podcasts. Enjoy!
items.title: ITPS114 REEKO

items.desc: Yamour has quickly gained a reputation for her versatility as a DJ, serving both House and Techno music with equal passion and finesse in her vinyl-only sets. Besides touring around the world, she is a regular guest at Giegling events and at Blitz Club in Munich. Enjoy!
items.title: ITPS113 YAMOUR

items.desc: Los Angeles artist 1morning is one of the funkiest young producers in modern techno. His all-vinyl DJ sets and pumping productions on labels likes Character and Fixed Rhythms stand out. Enjoy!
items.title: ITPS112 1MORNING

items.desc: Honcho is a DJ and curation trio made up of Aaron Clark, Clark Price & d'Adhemar. A pillar of the new American wave of queer underground house and techno, Honcho is a resident party at the infamous Hot Mass club in Pittsburgh and it also has become known for their annual Honcho Campout festival. Enjoy!
items.title: ITPS111 HONCHO

items.desc: Berlin-based DJ and radio host Elke radiates high energy – whether through playful electro, garage, and jungle or via percussive techno, bassy rollers, and stone-cold drumfunk. She is also a resident at Open Ground in Wuppertal. Enjoy!
items.title: ITPS110 ELKE

items.desc: Dub Athlete is a multi-genre artist based in Brighton. With her roots in dub and dubstep, you can hear an affinity for the minimal, psychedelic and heavyweight in her selections which span from introspective ambience to hypnotic and tribal techno, deep dubstep and dark jungle. She is a resident DJ for The Mine, and since 2019 has organised the Fortune Sessions, platforming underground dance music genres and talented local DJs. Available on SoundCloud & Apple Podcasts. Enjoy!
items.title: ITPS109 DUB ATHLETE

items.desc: Pugilist is a Melbourne based producer & DJ, releasing multi genre bass music on labels like 3024, Rupture and Modern Hypnosis. Enjoy!
items.title: ITPS108 PUGILIST
